facebook.caption:
POV: you took a wrong turn in the jungle and found a waterfall instead.

Fairy Waterfall sits in the north of Phu Quoc, away from the beach crowds. 4.3 stars across 210 reviews. Not massive. Not loud. Just cold fresh water, green canopy overhead, and zero beach vendors.

Wear shoes you can get wet. Go early. The light through the trees before 9am is worth the drive alone.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
